name: motion-web
title_zh: 动效先行的创意网站，从版式到滚动动画一气呵成
tagline_zh: 做落地页总在最后补动画，结果生硬又返工？这套 Skill 把动效当第一公民，版式、字阶、配色。
tagline_en: Tired of bolting on animations at the end? This skill designs page structure and motion as one—scroll effects.
desc_en: Design and build motion-first creative websites — page design (macrostructure, type scale, palette, spacing) and interaction choreography together, with scroll animation, Framer Motion, GSAP, and light 3D via Three.js/R3F.
